decision.reason: This operation has a distinct runtime-maintenance purpose and should not be folded into ACTUALIZACION_PERFIL_LF, but PRODUCCION_CONTROLADA with zero ACTIVE_ENFORCEMENT bindings is inconsistent with governed writes.
decision.reason_not_to_clone_profile_bindings: Its step set includes runtime_resolve and runtime-specific evidence. Reusing the shared profile judge would reproduce the one-judge-for-N-steps defect and step-60 semantic leakage.

preconditions_before_reenable: define runtime-specific per-step judge topology or justified structural judge topology
materialize ACTIVE_ENFORCEMENT bindings for every active required step
positive governed runtime-update execution reaches github_readback without bypass
dispose or explicitly supersede the two IN_PROGRESS executions
